responsibility: Implements the symbol-table side of pass 3. It creates and enters module and procedure scopes for the executable parse, checks imported-symbol legality against exporting modules, finalizes queued subrange types from pass 2, resolves constant declarations to symbols, records explicit-address variables and optional-argument initializers, and performs end-of-module unknown-symbol checks, while leaving executable statement and expression IR emission to `M2Quads`.
same_name_distinction: This implementation module realizes the pass-3 symbol-building helpers declared in P3SymBuild.def; unlike the .def file, it performs the actual module/procedure scope management, import validation, queued subrange completion, and symbol-table updates during pass 3.
